stories.title: Ed Sheeran wirft Macklemore bei seiner Tour raus

en.title: Ed Sheeran removes Macklemore from his tour
en.summary: Rapper Macklemore performed twice as an opening act on Ed Sheeran's tour and used the stage to call for Free Palestine. The collaboration has now ended, with Macklemore claiming he is being silenced.

stories.title: Umar Kremlew: Oligarch soll Hochzeitsfeier von Donald Trump Jr. mitfinanziert haben

en.title: Umar Kremlyev: Oligarch reportedly helped finance Donald Trump Jr.'s wedding celebration
en.summary: A Russian oligarch allegedly contributed six-figure sums toward Donald Trump Jr.'s wedding celebration. His wife characterizes the contribution as a wedding gift.

stories.title: Hannover 96 trennt sich von Trainer Titz – übernimmt jetzt Sandro Wagner?

en.title: Hannover 96 parts ways with coach Titz – could Sandro Wagner take over?
en.summary: Hannover 96, seeking promotion, has won only one of five matches and has terminated coach Christian Titz. The club is reportedly negotiating with a potential successor.

stories.title: Aufstiegskandidat: Hannover 96 entlässt Trainer Christian Titz

en.title: Promotion contender: Hannover 96 dismisses coach Christian Titz
en.summary: Three days after losing to Nuremberg, Hannover 96 has removed coach Christian Titz. Sports director Jonas Boldt states a reset was necessary.

stories.title: Hochzeitsfeier von Donald Trump Jr. wurde teilweise von russischem Oligarchen finanziert

en.title: Donald Trump Jr.'s wedding was partially financed by Russian oligarch
en.summary: Donald Trump Jr.'s wedding on a Bahamian island was reportedly funded in part by a Putin-linked oligarch, whom the couple thanked on Instagram.

stories.title: Oasis kündigt Konzerte in Deutschland an

en.title: Oasis announces concerts in Germany
en.summary: British rock band Oasis plans to perform two concerts in Munich in 2027 as part of a world tour, marking their first performances in Germany since 2009.

stories.title: Künstliche Intelligenz, Warnungen der Techbosse: Donald Trump spricht von einer »Verschwörung gegen KI«, China von Panikmache

en.title: Artificial Intelligence, warnings from tech bosses: Donald Trump speaks of a "conspiracy against AI", China of scaremongering
en.summary: US technology leaders are calling for better AI security measures, while President Trump prioritizes winning the tech competition and China downplays concerns. The report examines prospects for agreement among major AI powers.

stories.title: Tankstellenverband erwartet Spritpreise um die drei Euro

en.title: Petrol station association expects fuel prices around three euros
en.summary: Fuel, heating oil and gas prices are rising significantly due to Middle East escalation, prompting renewed political discussions about potential relief measures.

stories.title: Erstmals seit 2009: Oasis kündigt Konzerte in Deutschland an

en.title: For the first time since 2009: Oasis announces concerts in Germany
en.summary: The reunited band Oasis has announced concert dates, with German fans now able to attend performances in the country.

stories.title: USA unter Trump: Trump: „Kranke Verschwörung“ gegen KI

en.title: USA under Trump: Trump: "Sick conspiracy" against AI
en.summary: Donald Trump characterizes opposition to artificial intelligence as a conspiracy. Trump also reduces military exercises with South Korea.

stories.title: Energie: Tankstellenverband hält drei Euro pro Liter für möglich

en.title: Energy: petrol station association considers three euros per litre possible
en.summary: Fuel prices in Germany have risen sharply over the weekend, with industry representatives suggesting they could climb further. The association attributes rising prices to low fuel costs in the United States, forcing energy companies to seek profits elsewhere.

stories.title: Einzelhandel: Lidl testet autonom fahrenden Lkw zur Belieferung der Filialen

en.title: Retail: Lidl tests autonomous truck for store deliveries
en.summary: German discount retailer Lidl has received approval to conduct an initial test of autonomous trucks for supplying its stores. The company still needs to address several questions before widespread deployment.

stories.title: Wall Street: Tech-Titel fallen nach den Warnungen vor einer KI-Katastrophe deutlich

en.title: Wall Street: Tech stocks fall sharply after warnings of AI catastrophe
en.summary: Technology stocks declined as investors reacted with concern to calls from leaders at Anthropic and OpenAI for slowing AI development, though analysts hold more nuanced views on the matter.

stories.title: USA: Russischer Oligarch finanzierte Hochzeit von Trump-Sohn mit

en.title: USA: Russian oligarch financed wedding of Trump's son
en.summary: A Russian oligarch with ties to Putin allegedly funded portions of Donald Trump Jr.'s wedding celebration while Russia conducts military operations in Ukraine. Trump Jr.'s wife expressed no concern about the arrangement.

stories.title: Bayer-Anhörung: Monsanto fordert von US-Gericht Genehmigung des „Roundup“-Vergleichs

en.title: Bayer hearing: Monsanto seeks US court approval of "Roundup" settlement
en.summary: A US court considered a potential billion-dollar settlement for Bayer on Monday that would resolve tens of thousands of lawsuits. A decision has not yet been reached.

stories.title: Staatsschulden: „Nationale Pflicht“: Griechenland beschleunigt die Rückzahlung der Hilfskredite

en.title: State Debt: "National Duty": Greece Accelerates Repayment of Emergency Loans
en.summary: Greece is accelerating repayment of emergency loans, expecting to achieve savings in the billions and improve its credit rating.
